empty.skipped_other: Kept {{count}} folders used in the last 7 days.
empty.confirm.simulators: Reset {{size}} of simulators that are shut down?
empty.confirm.vms: Delete {{size}} of virtual machines unused for over 30 days?
empty.confirm.models: Delete {{size}} of AI models unused for over 30 days?
empty.detail.cache: They are deleted right away, without the Trash. Folders used in the last 7 days are kept. Apps make them again when needed, so the first use may be a little slower.
empty.detail.packages: They are deleted right away, without the Trash. Projects used in the last 7 days are kept. A deleted project needs pnpm install (or npm install) before it runs again.
empty.detail.build: They are deleted right away, without the Trash. Folders used in the last 7 days are kept. A deleted project's next build starts from scratch and takes longer.
empty.detail.trash: The files in the Trash are deleted for good.
empty.detail.docker: Only images and build cache no container uses are deleted. Containers and volumes are kept. They are downloaded again when needed.
empty.detail.simulators: Apps and data inside iOS simulators that are shut down are wiped, back to a fresh state. Running simulators are skipped. Apps signed in inside a simulator need signing in again.
empty.detail.wallpapers: Deletes the videos macOS downloaded for moving wallpapers and screen savers. The one in use is kept; others download again when picked.
empty.detail.vms: Deletes whole lima virtual machines that are stopped and unused for over 30 days. Files that were only inside them cannot be brought back.
empty.detail.models: When ollama is not running and unused for over 30 days, all model files are deleted. Use ollama pull to download one again.

computers.noQuit: {{names}} can't be quit from here. Terminals and editors would end their sessions, and node that isn't a dev server may be an AI tool or a build.
